name: Restoration Inbound Calls

hero.headline: Restoration Inbound Calls
hero.subheadline: Connect with high-intent consumers actively looking for restoration solutions.

overview: Restoration Inbound Calls are consumers who see an offer and dial in themselves, generated by Altarious Global performance campaigns and delivered to your business in real time. Connect property owners recovering from fire, smoke, mould, storm and water events with full-service restoration contractors.

After a fire or the discovery of mould, property owners want a human voice who can tell them what happens next. Inbound Call programs place local restoration offers in front of owners searching for help and connect them directly with the contractor's intake team. Callers arrive at a moment of high need and high trust-seeking, and contractors who respond with empathy, a clear process and a prompt site visit typically secure the project. Because inbound callers come directly rather than through an insurer network, contractors retain control of pricing and scope.

This product is suited to home services businesses with a team ready to answer during defined hours, a clear view of the consumer they want, and the capacity to convert a live conversation. The acquisition objective is simple: put your team in front of restoration consumers at the moment they are deciding.
targetConsumer: Homeowners, landlords, HOAs and commercial property managers dealing with a recent property loss that requires professional remediation and rebuilding. The most valuable segments are insured fire and major water losses that include reconstruction, mould remediation cases discovered during a sale or renovation, and multi-property owners affected by a regional storm event.
consumerIntent: Typical intent signals include: searching for fire damage restoration, mould remediation or restoration company near me; recent house fire, kitchen fire or smoke event in the property; visible mould growth or a failed mould inspection during a home sale; storm, tornado, hurricane or wildfire damage in the area.
howGenerated: Calls are generated through call-only and click-to-call performance campaigns targeting searches such as "restoration company near me" and "fire damage restoration", alongside social and comparison placements. Every source is tracked, so call quality can be traced back to the campaign that produced it.
qualification: Qualification is configured to your appetite. Standard restoration criteria include: property located within the contractor's service area; owner, property manager or authorised representative of the property; type of loss identified as fire, smoke, mould, storm, water or biohazard; residential or commercial property type confirmed; insurance claim status established, whether filed, approved or self-pay; ready to schedule an on-site assessment or estimate.
delivery: Calls are routed to your sales line in real time by state or ZIP, schedule and agent availability, with concurrency limits and daily caps set to your capacity. Call tracking and recording are available for quality control.

process.title: PPC / Traffic Acquisition
process.text: Performance campaigns across search, social and comparison placements reach consumers actively looking for restoration solutions.

process.title: Consumer Interest
process.text: The consumer sees a relevant restoration offer with a prominent phone number and a clear reason to call.

process.title: Call Initiated
process.text: The consumer dials directly from the ad or landing page. Nobody is cold-called; the consumer chooses to reach out.

process.title: Qualification
process.text: Optional IVR prompts and duration thresholds screen out wrong numbers, non-prospects and out-of-area callers.

process.title: Inbound Call Delivered
process.text: The call rings your team in real time, routed by geography, schedule and agent availability.

faq.q: Can programs focus on specific loss types such as fire or mould?
faq.a: Yes. Campaigns and screening can be configured around fire and smoke, mould remediation, storm damage or reconstruction, individually or in combination.

faq.q: Can restoration calls be activated after a regional disaster?
faq.a: Response campaigns can be deployed in affected areas within days of a storm or wildfire event, with screening tuned to the type of damage that occurred.

faq.q: Do you distinguish insured from self-pay losses?
faq.a: Insurance claim status is captured during screening so that you can prioritise insured, full-scope projects or accept self-pay work according to your business model.
